coordinates.origin: Centre of ground-contact claw footprint; meters retained

concept.reason: Primary complete fossil and life cross-section diagrams plus SEM plate geometry directly establish structure. Additional generated concept would add no factual certainty.

name.zh: 微网虫（具甲叶足动物研究）

scope: Original whole-organism low-poly reconstruction in resting/walking pose. Nine paired perforated dorsal-lateral sclerites above nine paired non-jointed lobopods, long limbless anterior extension. No fossil slab-only substitution.
geology: Early Cambrian Chengjiang Lagerstätte, Yunnan, China.
material_policy: Opaque palette-only PBR. Soft muted warm-grey trunk, contrasting slightly darker or paler sclerites, restrained claw contrast. Colour is artistic, not fossil evidence.

scale.status: Approximate representative size based on Fig1a YRCP0041 and its 10mm scale bar, not a direct specimen measurement or species maximum.
scale.shape_dimensions_note: Minor dimensions estimated from published complete fossil with compaction uncertainty; record generated dimensions rather than implying live soft-body metrics are known.

diagnostic_targets: Elongate annulated cylindrical soft trunk, gently tapering into a flexible limbless anterior extension with a small terminal mouth. No invented armored head or large eyes.
Exactly nine pairs of ovoid/elliptical perforated sclerites on dorsal-lateral shoulders, one pair aligned with each leg pair; not a single midline row or continuous shell.
Nine leg pairs in this frozen reconstruction, following Chen et al2024 likely-nine interpretation, not ten from older reconstructions. Preserve terminal pair shortest.
Slender non-jointed tube-like legs with small paired terminal claws. No elbow joints, carapace legs or insect foot anatomy.
Each plate has visibly real through-openings forming a coarse reticulated network; flat dot textures or plain oval shields do not meet the original perforated-plate cue.
Plates curve slightly over trunk sides and remain discrete; no giant decorative spikes or antennae.
Use normal intermolt state, one plate per side at each station; published double/stacked plates illustrate molting, not four permanent rows.
uncertainties: Nine versus ten appendage pairs disputed historically. This version uses the newer paper’s explicitly tentative nine-pair interpretation, not a claim of certainty.
Anterior identity is inferred from comparison with related lobopodians; no visible eye details are established here.
Soft-body cross-section, pose and colour reconstructed. Plate hole count is deliberately simplified for low-poly viewing, not an exact microfossil reproduction.
Fig2 concerns Microdictyon sp. isolated plates; use for reticulation architecture only, not exact individual plate dimensions of M.sinicum.
acceptance_checklist: Whole animal, long soft anterior extension and nine paired plate/leg stations clearly visible.
Top shows bilateral rows; side shows each sclerite above associated leg; final pair shortest.
Plate mesh visibly perforated in exact-GLB renders, not painted holes.
Legs nonjointed and separate, small paired claws, no fused-floor or intersecting plates.
Metadata explicitly discloses inferred nine-pair choice, soft-body reconstruction and artistic palette.
Four exact-GLB views, standard format/source tests and cheap two rebuilds; independent QA separate.
